title: haex-hive install.lock v2 (Spec-007 subset)
description: Schema for .haex-hive/install.lock as authored by Spec 007. Spec 008 will extend this with atoms[] and generated_content_integrity fields. Spec 007's write MUST preserve unknown top-level fields for forward compatibility (FR-030 forward-compat clause). This schema does NOT set additionalProperties: false at the root, because Spec 008 will add root fields.

canonicalSourceUrl.description: Credential-free canonical https:// or ssh:// URL: lowercase host, non-empty path, no trailing slash, and no terminal .git. SCP-style and ssh transport-user inputs are normalized before storage.

sha256Base64.description: SHA-256 digest in Subresource Integrity format: 'sha256-' + standard base64 (with padding). See R11.

sources.$comment: Draft 2020-12 cannot compare an object property across array items. The required haex post-schema semantic validator enforces unique sources[].id values and ascending bytewise UTF-8 id order.
sources.description: Contributing atoms. After Draft 2020-12 structural validation, the required haex semantic validator rejects duplicate ids and requires ascending bytewise UTF-8 id order; JSON Schema cannot compare properties of distinct object items.

content_integrity.description: SHA-256 of D15's haex-hive-tree-v1 one-file tree for constitution.md.
